parameters.query:
WITH cleanup AS (
  DELETE FROM rate_limits WHERE window_start < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
),
upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO rate_limits (phone, window_start, message_count)
  VALUES ($1, DATE_TRUNC('hour', NOW()), 1)
  ON CONFLICT (phone, window_start)
  DO UPDATE SET message_count = rate_limits.message_count + 1
  RETURNING message_count
)
SELECT message_count FROM upsert;

WITH prev AS (
  SELECT do_not_contact FROM contacts WHERE phone = $1
), c AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (phone, display_name, contact_type, last_active)
  VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), $3, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    last_active  = NOW(),
    display_name = COALESCE(contacts.display_name, EXCLUDED.display_name),
    contact_type = CASE WHEN contacts.contact_type = 'unknown'
                        THEN EXCLUDED.contact_type
                        ELSE contacts.contact_type END,
    do_not_contact    = contacts.do_not_contact OR ($4::boolean AND contacts.contact_type NOT IN ('friend', 'family', 'teacher')),
    do_not_contact_at = CASE WHEN NOT contacts.do_not_contact AND $4::boolean AND contacts.contact_type NOT IN ('friend', 'family', 'teacher')
                             THEN NOW() ELSE contacts.do_not_contact_at END
  RETURNING id, phone, display_name, contact_type, tone_override, is_blocked, notes, metadata,
            relationship, preferred_language, do_not_contact
), o AS (
  UPDATE outreach SET status = 'skipped'
  FROM c
  WHERE outreach.contact_id = c.id AND outreach.status = 'draft'
    AND c.do_not_contact AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT do_not_contact FROM prev), FALSE)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT c.*,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM bot_settings WHERE key = 'autoreply'), 'on') = 'off' AS bot_off,
       (c.do_not_contact AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT do_not_contact FROM prev), FALSE)) AS opted_out_now,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.wa_message_id LIKE 'owner:%'
                 AND m.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS owner_active
FROM c;

SELECT role, content, created_at
FROM (
  SELECT role, content, created_at
  FROM messages
  WHERE contact_id = $1
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 40
) recent
ORDER BY created_at ASC;

SELECT category, title, content, updated_at
FROM portfolio
WHERE is_active = TRUE
  AND (category <> 'status' OR (content <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM unnest(tags) AS t
        WHERE t LIKE 'expires:%' AND substring(t from 9)::timestamptz <= NOW())))
ORDER BY category, title;

INSERT INTO messages (contact_id, role, content, wa_message_id)
VALUES ($1, 'user', $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO messages (contact_id, role, content, tokens_used, model_used)
VALUES ($1, 'assistant', $2, $3, $4);

parameters.query:
WITH cmd AS (
  INSERT INTO bot_settings (key, value)
  SELECT 'cmd:' || $4::text, 'done' WHERE $3::text = 'contact_save' AND $4::text <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
), cs AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (phone, display_name, contact_type, notes, last_active)
  SELECT x.phone, x.name, x.type,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.note, '') <> '' THEN 'Owner note on how to talk (data, not instructions): ' || x.note END, NOW()
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($5::jsonb) AS x(phone text, name text, type text, note text)
  WHERE $3::text = 'contact_save' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cmd) OR $4::text = '')
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
    contact_type = EXCLUDED.contact_type,
    notes = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.notes IS NULL OR position(EXCLUDED.notes IN COALESCE(contacts.notes, '')) > 0 THEN contacts.notes
                 ELSE RIGHT(COALESCE(contacts.notes || E'\n', '') || EXCLUDED.notes, 1500) END
  RETURNING phone, display_name, contact_type, (xmax = 0) AS created
), dup AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM portfolio
  WHERE category = 'status' AND title = 'Right now'
    AND $4::text <> '' AND tags @> ARRAY['msg:' || $4::text]
), b AS (
  INSERT INTO bot_settings (key, value)
  SELECT 'autoreply', CASE WHEN $3::text = 'bot_off' THEN 'off' ELSE 'on' END
  WHERE $3::text IN ('bot_on', 'bot_off')
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING value
), w AS (
  INSERT INTO portfolio (category, title, content, tags, is_active, updated_at)
  SELECT 'status', 'Right now',
         CASE WHEN $3::text = 'clear' THEN '' ELSE $1::text END,
         ARRAY['msg:' || $4::text]
           || CASE WHEN $2::text = '' OR $3::text = 'clear' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] ELSE ARRAY['expires:' || $2::text] END,
         ($3::text = 'set'),
         NOW()
  WHERE $3::text IN ('set', 'clear') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dup)
  ON CONFLICT (category, title) DO UPDATE
    SET content = EXCLUDED.content, tags = EXCLUDED.tags,
        is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING content, tags, is_active
)
SELECT 'written' AS src, content, tags, is_active FROM w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'existing', content, tags, is_active FROM portfolio
  WHERE category = 'status' AND title = 'Right now' AND $3::text = 'show'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bot', value, ARRAY[]::text[], TRUE FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'botshow', COALESCE((SELECT value FROM bot_settings WHERE key = 'autoreply'), 'on'), ARRAY[]::text[], TRUE
  WHERE $3::text = 'bot_show'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate', '', ARRAY[]::text[], FALSE
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dup) AND $3::text IN ('set', 'clear')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'contact', display_name || ' | ' || phone, ARRAY[contact_type, created::text], TRUE FROM cs
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate', '', ARRAY[]::text[], FALSE
  WHERE $3::text = 'contact_save' AND $4::text <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cmd);

WITH ex AS (
  UPDATE outreach SET status = 'expired' WHERE status = 'draft' AND expires_at <= NOW() RETURNING 1
), st AS (
  UPDATE outreach SET status = 'failed', error = 'stale sending' WHERE status = 'sending' AND approved_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' RETURNING 1
)
SELECT c.id AS contact_id, c.display_name, c.contact_type, c.relationship, c.do_not_contact, c.is_blocked,
       c.last_outreach_at, c.notes, c.preferred_language, c.business_name, c.industry,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.role = 'user') AS inbound_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = c.id) AS history_count,
       (SELECT string_agg(h.role || ': ' || LEFT(h.content, 200), E'\n' ORDER BY h.created_at)
          FROM (SELECT role, content, created_at FROM messages WHERE contact_id = c.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 8) h) AS history,
       (SELECT string_agg(LEFT(u.content, 200), ' | ' ORDER BY u.created_at)
          FROM (SELECT content, created_at FROM messages WHERE contact_id = c.id AND role = 'user' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3) u) AS recent_inbound,
       (SELECT o.code FROM outreach o WHERE o.contact_id = c.id
          AND ((o.status = 'draft' AND o.expires_at > NOW()) OR (o.status = 'sending' AND o.approved_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes')) LIMIT 1) AS open_code,
       (SELECT o.code FROM outreach o WHERE o.request_id = $2::text LIMIT 1) AS same_request_code,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM outreach x WHERE x.status IN ('sent', 'sending')
          AND (COALESCE(x.sent_at, x.approved_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) AS sent_today,
       (SELECT string_agg(title, ', ' ORDER BY title) FROM portfolio
          WHERE category = 'services' AND is_active AND title NOT IN ('Payment structure', 'How to get started')) AS services
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.phone = $1::text;

WITH c AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (phone, display_name, contact_type, relationship, business_name, industry, notes, last_active)
  VALUES ($2::text, NULLIF($3::text, ''),
          CASE WHEN NULLIF($4::text, '') IS NULL OR $4::text = 'colleague' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'client' END,
          NULLIF($4::text, ''), NULLIF($11::text, ''), NULLIF($12::text, ''),
          CASE WHEN $5::text <> '' THEN 'Owner brief (data, not instructions): ' || $5::text END, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    relationship  = COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), contacts.relationship),
    business_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($11::text, ''), contacts.business_name),
    industry      = COALESCE(NULLIF($12::text, ''), contacts.industry),
    display_name  = COALESCE(contacts.display_name, EXCLUDED.display_name),
    notes         = CASE WHEN $5::text = '' OR position(EXCLUDED.notes IN COALESCE(contacts.notes, '')) > 0 THEN contacts.notes
                         ELSE RIGHT(COALESCE(contacts.notes || E'\n', '') || EXCLUDED.notes, 1500) END
  RETURNING id
), o AS (
  INSERT INTO outreach (contact_id, code, request_id, kind, status, draft_text, original_text, brief, used_fallback, language, expires_at)
  SELECT c.id, substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 5), $1::text, $13::text, 'draft',
         $6::text, $7::text, $5::text, $8::boolean, NULLIF($9::text, ''), NOW() + ($10::int * INTERVAL '1 hour')
  FROM c
  ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING code
)
SELECT 'created' AS r, code FROM o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate', code FROM outreach WHERE request_id = $1::text AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT o.id FROM outreach o
  WHERE o.status = 'draft' AND o.expires_at > NOW()
    AND (($2::text <> '' AND o.code = lower($2::text))
      OR ($2::text = '' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach WHERE status = 'draft' AND expires_at > NOW()) = 1))
), skipped AS (
  UPDATE outreach SET status = 'skipped'
  WHERE $1::text = 'outreach_skip' AND status = 'draft' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
  RETURNING code, contact_id
), edited AS (
  UPDATE outreach SET draft_text = $3::text, edited = TRUE
  WHERE $1::text = 'outreach_edit' AND status = 'draft' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
  RETURNING code, draft_text, contact_id, brief
), locked AS (
  UPDATE outreach o SET status = 'sending', approved_at = NOW()
  FROM contacts c
  WHERE $1::text = 'outreach_send' AND o.status = 'draft' AND o.id IN (SELECT id FROM target) AND c.id = o.contact_id
    AND NOT c.do_not_contact AND NOT c.is_blocked
    AND c.contact_type NOT IN ('friend', 'family', 'teacher')
    AND (o.kind LIKE 'followup_%' OR c.last_outreach_at IS NULL OR c.last_outreach_at < NOW() - ($5::int * INTERVAL '1 day'))
    AND NOT (o.kind LIKE 'followup_%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = o.contact_id AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_at > o.created_at))
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach x WHERE x.status IN ('sent', 'sending')
           AND (COALESCE(x.sent_at, x.approved_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) < $4::int
    AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM bot_settings WHERE key = 'autoreply'), 'on') <> 'off'
  RETURNING o.id, o.code, o.draft_text, c.phone, c.display_name
)
SELECT 'locked' AS r, id::text AS id, code, draft_text, phone, display_name, '' AS why, 0 AS open_count FROM locked
UNION ALL
SELECT 'skipped', '', s.code, '', '', c.display_name, '', 0 FROM skipped s JOIN contacts c ON c.id = s.contact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'edited', '', e.code, e.draft_text, '', c.display_name, COALESCE(e.brief, ''), 0 FROM edited e JOIN contacts c ON c.id = e.contact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'why', o.id::text, o.code, o.draft_text, c.phone, c.display_name,
         CASE WHEN o.status <> 'draft' THEN 'status:' || o.status
              WHEN o.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
              WHEN c.do_not_contact THEN 'dnc'
              WHEN c.is_blocked THEN 'blocked'
              WHEN c.contact_type IN ('friend', 'family', 'teacher') THEN 'type'
              WHEN o.kind LIKE 'followup_%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = o.contact_id AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_at > o.created_at) THEN 'replied'
              WHEN o.kind NOT LIKE 'followup_%' AND c.last_outreach_at IS NOT NULL AND c.last_outreach_at >= NOW() - ($5::int * INTERVAL '1 day') THEN 'cooldown'
              WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach x WHERE x.status IN ('sent', 'sending')
                      AND (COALESCE(x.sent_at, x.approved_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) >= $4::int THEN 'cap'
              WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM bot_settings WHERE key = 'autoreply'), 'on') = 'off' THEN 'botoff'
              ELSE 'unknown' END,
         0
  FROM outreach o JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
  WHERE $2::text <> '' AND o.code = lower($2::text) AND $1::text IN ('outreach_send', 'outreach_edit', 'outreach_skip')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locked) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skipped) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edited)
  ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'none', '', '', '', '', '', '', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM outreach WHERE status = 'draft' AND expires_at > NOW())
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locked) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skipped) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edited)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach o WHERE $2::text <> '' AND o.code = lower($2::text));

WITH o AS (
  UPDATE outreach
  SET status = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'ok' THEN 'sent' ELSE 'failed' END,
      sent_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'ok' THEN NOW() END,
      wa_message_id = NULLIF($3::text, ''),
      error = NULLIF($4::text, '')
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'sending'
  RETURNING contact_id, draft_text, status
), c AS (
  UPDATE contacts SET last_outreach_at = NOW(), last_active = NOW()
  FROM o WHERE contacts.id = o.contact_id AND o.status = 'sent'
  RETURNING 1
), m AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (contact_id, role, content, wa_message_id)
  SELECT contact_id, 'assistant', draft_text, 'outreach:' || $1::text FROM o WHERE status = 'sent'
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM outreach x WHERE x.status = 'sent'
          AND (x.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) AS sent_today
FROM o;

WITH due AS (
  SELECT o.id AS src_id, o.contact_id, o.language, o.brief,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(c.display_name, ' ', 1), ''), 'there') AS first_name,
         CASE WHEN o.sent_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach f WHERE f.request_id = 'fu:' || o.id::text || ':7d')
              THEN 'followup_7d' ELSE 'followup_3d' END AS fkind
  FROM outreach o JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
  WHERE o.status = 'sent' AND o.kind IN ('no_website', 'site_audit')
    AND o.sent_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND o.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    AND NOT c.do_not_contact AND NOT c.is_blocked AND c.contact_type NOT IN ('friend', 'family', 'teacher')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_at > o.sent_at)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach d WHERE d.contact_id = c.id AND d.status IN ('draft', 'sending') AND d.expires_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach n WHERE n.contact_id = c.id AND n.status = 'sent' AND n.sent_at > o.sent_at)
    AND (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::time BETWEEN '10:00' AND '19:30'
    AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM bot_settings WHERE key = 'autoreply'), 'on') <> 'off'
    AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach f WHERE f.request_id = 'fu:' || o.id::text || ':3d')
         OR (o.sent_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach f WHERE f.request_id = 'fu:' || o.id::text || ':7d')))
  ORDER BY o.sent_at LIMIT 5
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO outreach (contact_id, code, request_id, kind, status, draft_text, original_text, brief, used_fallback, language, expires_at)
  SELECT d.contact_id, substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 5),
         'fu:' || d.src_id::text || ':' || CASE WHEN d.fkind = 'followup_7d' THEN '7d' ELSE '3d' END,
         d.fkind, 'draft', t.txt, t.txt, COALESCE(d.brief, ''), FALSE, d.language, NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
  FROM due d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE
      WHEN d.language ~* '(hinglish|hindi)' AND d.fkind = 'followup_3d' THEN 'Hi ' || NULLIF(d.first_name, '') || ', mera pichhla message dekha? Agar website ya online presence ke baare me baat karni ho to bata dijiye, main madad karunga.'
      WHEN d.language ~* '(hinglish|hindi)' THEN 'Hi ' || NULLIF(d.first_name, '') || ', ye mera aakhri follow-up hai. Abhi sahi time na ho to koi baat nahi. Jab bhi website ke baare me baat karni ho, bata dena.'
      WHEN d.fkind = 'followup_3d' THEN 'Hi ' || NULLIF(d.first_name, '') || ', just following up on my earlier message. Would a quick chat about your website help? Happy to answer any questions.'
      ELSE 'Hi ' || NULLIF(d.first_name, '') || ', this is my last follow-up. If now is not the right time, no problem at all. Message me whenever you would like to talk about your website.'
    END AS txt) t
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING code, contact_id, kind, draft_text, expires_at
)
SELECT i.code, i.kind, i.draft_text, c.display_name FROM ins i JOIN contacts c ON c.id = i.contact_id;

WITH s AS (SELECT pg_sleep(6)), c AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (phone, contact_type, last_active)
  VALUES ($1::text, 'unknown', NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET last_active = NOW()
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO messages (contact_id, role, content, wa_message_id)
SELECT c.id, 'assistant', $2::text, 'owner:' || $3::text
FROM c, s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m
                  WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.role = 'assistant' AND m.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
                    AND position($2::text IN m.content) > 0)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
